Running a 1B model on a Raspberry Pi

This weekend I got a one billion parameter small language model running on a Raspberry Pi 5 with 8GB of RAM.

Using 4-bit quantization and llama.cpp, generation speed reached roughly six tokens per second, which is plenty for a home assistant.

The key tricks were memory-mapped weights, a smaller context window, and pinning the process to the performance cores so thermal throttling stayed manageable.

Next I want to try speculative decoding with an even tinier draft model to see if I can double throughput without a quality loss.
